integrity: The stated theorem and boundary-layer proof are derived analytically; bundled arithmetic verifies representative cases but cannot prove universal quantifiers. First public source date is verified arXiv posting, not a later revision or publication date.
limitations: Does not assert C^m neighborhoods at m-fold ties for m>=3, smoothness at coordinate-zero seams, a result for arbitrary convex bodies, or p=infinity; original 2026 cube moment formula is acknowledged.
scientific_scope: For every finite real p>-1 and every dimension n>=3, the gauge of the radial p-mean body of a cube/parallelotope; exact Peano-contact coefficients and optimal local C2,1 regularity.
title: Sharp differentiability strata of radial mean bodies of parallelotopes
